source_decisions.basis: The Truman Library provides Executive Order 9621, issued by President Truman on September 20, 1945: https://www.trumanlibrary.gov/library/executive-orders/9621/executive-order-9621. It is an official presidential work covered by 17 U.S.C. §105: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCODE-2024-title17/pdf/USCODE-2024-title17-chap1-sec105.pdf.

The Truman Library provides the January 22, 1946 Directive on Coordination of Foreign Intelligence Activities: https://www.trumanlibrary.gov/library/public-papers/19/directive-coordination-foreign-intelligence-activities. It is an official presidential work covered by 17 U.S.C. §105: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCODE-2024-title17/pdf/USCODE-2024-title17-chap1-sec105.pdf.

GovInfo's official March 14, 1947 Congressional Record granule contains the Senate address and the cited material on pages 2068–2069: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GPO-CRECB-1947-pt2/pdf/GPO-CRECB-1947-pt2-13-1.pdf. The excerpt is official congressional authorship covered by 17 U.S.C. §105, with Congress expressly included by the Copyright Office Compendium: https://www.copyright.gov/comp3/docs/compendium.pdf.
